meta.title: ERBA – European Regulatory Burden Alliance
meta.description: Europe's real economy has had enough. Join the movement measuring the real cost of cumulative EU regulation.
meta.joinTitle: Join Free – Add Your Regulatory Pain
meta.joinDescription: Register your company and log the annual cost of your worst EU regulatory burden. Anonymous option available.
meta.loginDescription: Sign in to the ERBA member dashboard.
meta.painIndexTitle: The Pain Index – Documented Cost of EU Regulation
meta.painIndexDescription: Live, crowd-sourced total of annual compliance costs reported by European mid-cap companies, broken down by regulation.

footer.blurb: Koalizzjoni indipendenti ta' CEOs mid-cap li tiddokumenta l-ispiża kumulattiva tar-regolazzjoni tal-UE, punt tad-dejta wara l-ieħor.
footer.anonymousNote: Sottomissjonijiet anonimi qatt ma jiġu attribwiti lil kumpanija msemmija.

landing.subhead: Ir-regolazzjoni kumulattiva tal-UE qed toqtol il-kompetittività. Ingħaqad mal-moviment li jkejjel l-ispiża vera.
landing.noFees: Bla ħlas. Bla baġit ta' lobbying. Għażla anonima.
landing.whyNowTitle: It-tieqa biex tibdel il-kors qed tagħlaq.
landing.whyNowLead: Tliet forzi iltaqgħu f'18-il xahar. Flimkien jagħmlu s-skiet agħar mit-taħdit.
landing.farmerBody: Tratturi bblokkaw Brussell, Pariġi u Berlin. Il-bdiewa urew li meta l-ekonomija reali timbotta flimkien, il-Kummissjoni tisma'. Il-mid-caps għadhom ma qajmux leħinhom.
landing.greenBody: CSRD, CSDDD, EUDR, CBAM, it-tassonomija. Kull regola waħedha tidher 'manigġabbli'. Flimkien jibilgħu timijiet sħaħ tal-finanzi u l-liġi.
landing.mercosurBody: Ftehimiet kummerċjali jiftħu l-bieb għal kompetituri mingħajr dawn l-obbligi. L-Ewropa tesporta l-bażi industrijali tagħha u timporta oġġetti prodotti taħt regoli eħfef.
landing.howTitle: Numru wieħed li Brussell ma tistax targumenta kontrih.
landing.howLead: L-anekdoti jitwarrbu. Dejta aggregata u verifikabbli tal-ispejjeż le. ERBA tibdel l-uġigħ tal-konformità f'punt tal-aġenda.
landing.step2Body: Agħżel ir-regolazzjoni l-aktar tqila u stima l-piż annwali.
landing.step3Body: Id-dejta tiegħek titma' l-Pain Index pubbliku li dawk li jieħdu d-deċiżjonijiet ma jistgħux jinjoraw.
landing.closeTitle: L-ispiża tal-konformità tiegħek hija fatt politiku.
landing.closeLead: Ingħaqad ma' {count} kumpaniji diġà rreġistrati. Jieħu inqas milli taqra rekwiżit CSRD wieħed.

join.title: Poġġi l-ispiża tal-konformità fuq ir-rekord.
join.lead: {count} kumpaniji diġà ddokumentaw {cost} ta' piż regolatorju. Kull punt ġdid jagħmel in-numru aktar diffiċli li jiġi injorat.
join.anonBody: L-ispiża tgħodd; l-isem tal-kumpanija jista' jibqa' moħbi.
join.neverBody: Dejta aggregata biss għall-advocacy, qatt ma tinqasam mal-fornituri.

painIndex.title: The Pain Index
painIndex.lead: Total annual compliance cost documented by European companies, regulation by regulation.
painIndex.leaderboardTitle: Which regulation costs Europe the most?
painIndex.ranked: Ranked by total documented annual cost
painIndex.emptyBody: The Pain Index starts with the first company brave enough to put a number on it. Be the first data point.
painIndex.method: Methodology: figures are self-reported annual compliance cost estimates submitted by member companies. Company identities are never displayed; anonymous submissions are included in aggregates. Totals refresh every minute.
painIndex.cta: Is your company facing these costs?
